faq_q1: How does working remotely with Zentix work?
faq_a1: We work async-first with clear milestones and regular updates. You always know what is being built, what is next, and when it ships. We overlap working hours with clients across time zones for calls when needed.
faq_q2: What does your project process look like?
faq_a2: Four stages: Discover, where we map your goals and scope; Design and Build, where we craft and develop; Review, where you test and we refine; Launch and Support, where we ship and stay available afterwards.
faq_q3: How much does a project cost?
faq_a3: Every project is scoped individually. After a short discovery call you receive a fixed written quote, so the price is agreed before any work begins. No hourly surprises.
faq_a4: 50% upfront to start the project and 50% on delivery. Final files and handover are released once the final payment is complete.
faq_q5: How long does a typical project take?
faq_a5: Landing pages typically take one to two weeks. Full websites and online stores usually take three to six weeks depending on scope. You get a realistic timeline in your quote.
faq_q6: Do you provide support after launch?
faq_a6: Yes. Every launch includes a handover, and ongoing support and maintenance options are available so your site or app keeps running smoothly.
